hooks.text: 击败对手并争夺水晶得分，积累水晶会增大体型和攻击范围，但同时降低移动速度。
hooks.excerpt: Kill your opponent in the arena, and grab the dropped crystals to gain points. Players with the highest points will win the game. The more points players get, the bigger they will become, and the attack range will become bigger. However, be careful, the movement speed will also decrease at the same time…
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 竞技地图把毒液、草丛、毒雾和龙卷风变成持续影响交战的环境机关。
hooks.excerpt: The competitive map is full of crises, highly toxic contaminated liquid, hidden grass, weak and slow poisonous fog, and inaccessible tornadoes, making the battle more tense and exciting.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 同时提供单人乱斗、三人组队和自定义房间对战。
hooks.excerpt: "1P" is the individual battle mode for a single player; "3P" is the team battle mode for 3 players. There is also a custom open room mode to invite friends to play against each other.
